title: Kissed Mustardy Japanese Pork Ramen Miso
description: A light and flavorful Japanese dish featuring pork, mustard, and miso, with a pillowy texture and a hint of sweetness from the jam, this flexitarian-friendly ramen is a delightful twist on traditional Japanese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat to deep-fry the pork loin strips until golden brown.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In the same pot, add the sliced green onions and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, and miso paste to the pot, whisking until the miso is dissolved.
Bring the broth to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the whole grain mustard and jam until well combined.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot with the broth and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the mustard and jam mixture, then add the cooked pork back to the pot.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot garnished with sesame seeds.
